referencePolicy: cat v1 redrawn first; school/apple v1 subjects redrawn using cat v2 as style reference

prompts.prompt: Edit target: the supplied orange-and-cream cat illustration. Preserve ONLY the subject identity (one seated orange-and-cream cat with a curled tail) and transparent background. Completely redraw it in a MUCH SIMPLER, lightweight flat 2D editorial illustration style for an adult Japanese-learning flashcard. Use about 5 broad solid color shapes, softly rounded geometric silhouette, small dark dot eyes, tiny nose, simple curved mouth, only a few short whisker strokes and at most 3 broad orange stripe marks. Friendly and calm, not babyish. No individually rendered hairs, no realistic fur, no realistic anatomy shading, no realistic glass eyes, no watercolor brush texture, no paper grain, no photographic lighting, no glossy 3D volume. Broad matte pastel orange and warm cream, with dark forest-green facial lines. This should look like a clean simple Japanese stationery spot illustration readable at a 96px thumbnail, not a painted animal portrait. One subject only, full ears/paws/tail visible, centered with comfortable clear margins. Output a 4:3 landscape PNG, ideally 1448x1086, truly transparent alpha. No writing, no labels, no border, no white sticker outline, no background circle, no extra objects. The attached image is an edit target for subject, not a style reference.

Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET for its subject only. Image 2 (the new simplified cat) is the STYLE REFERENCE, not a subject to include. Redraw image 1 completely to match image 2's lightweight simple 2D Japanese stationery illustration style. Use broad smooth matte pastel color areas, softly rounded geometric shapes, gentle minimal shading and very few small details. NO realistic painting, photographic detail, fine material texture, brush grain, complex lighting, shiny 3D volume, dense decorative objects or elaborate outlines. Clear instantly readable silhouette at 96px thumbnail size. One subject, centered and fully visible, generous clear margins. Preserve a truly transparent alpha background, 4:3 landscape PNG about 1448x1086. No background panel, no circle, no card frame, no white sticker border. Absolutely NO words, letters, labels, numerals or watermark.
Subject: a friendly simplified two-storey school building. Use a warm cream rectangular facade, a single simple terracotta roof, one small circular clock with two hands and NO numerals, a central green entrance, and only 6-8 plain sage-blue classroom windows in total. A couple of simple rounded shrub shapes at the base are enough. Omit the original's individual roof tiles, realistic wall lines, classroom desks, detailed window reflections, detailed plants and masonry. Keep the subject recognizable as a school, but with roughly the same low level of visual detail as the reference cat. Do not draw a cat.

Subject: one simple red apple with a short brown stem and one smooth sage-green leaf. Create the fruit with a softly rounded red silhouette, at most one subtle shadow area and one small simple cream highlight. No skin pores, speckles, realistic gloss, leaf veins or fibrous stem texture. Match the clean simple charm and broad color areas of the reference cat. Do not draw a cat, cut slices, a basket or other objects.
